claims.claim: When moving, the registration is updated at both the old and the new address.
claims.quote: Include both your new address and, where requested, your previous address.
claims.note: The text says you give both addresses on one register to vote form and are then removed from the old address automatically, not that you update at both addresses separately.

claims.claim: The electoral register affects jury duty.
claims.quote: jury summoning in England, Wales and Northern Ireland
claims.note: The full register is used for jury summoning.

claims.claim: The electoral register affects credit checks.
claims.quote: checking applications for loans or credit
claims.note: The full register is used to check applications for loans or credit.
